name: Pug Mark Restaurant — Bandipur Safari Lodge (Jungle Lodges)
signature_dish: Buffet lunch with South Indian and Karnataka dishes
why_it_matters: The restaurant of Bandipur Safari Lodge, the Karnataka government's Jungle Lodges and Resorts property at Melukamanahalli on the Mysore-Ooty road near the park gate. The Gol Ghar — the open-sided gazebo dining hall standard to every JLR property — looks out toward Gopalaswamy Betta, Bandipur's highest peak; the roadside Pug Mark serves a buffet lunch open to non-residents.
insider_tip: It is a buffet operation with no a-la-carte, and meal slots follow the safari timetable — book ahead if you are not a resort guest. The tea is reviewers' standout. Bandipur has very few standalone restaurants, so in-resort dining like this is the realistic option. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: Bandipur Safari Lodge, Melukamanahalli, Mysore-Ooty Road, Bandipur, Chamarajanagar District, Karnataka 571126

name: Sanctuary Restaurant — The Serai Bandipur
area: The Serai Bandipur, near Bandipur reserve
why_it_matters: The fine-dining restaurant of The Serai Bandipur, one of the reserve's top luxury resorts — an elegant indoor-AC and outdoor-deck restaurant serving Indian and international cuisine, with the jungle bar Moyar's Edge alongside. Reviewers call the food some of the best they ate in India and praise the attentive, creative kitchen.
insider_tip: This is a luxury resort restaurant — non-resident dining must be arranged in advance and it is expensive. Best as part of a Serai stay. Moyar's Edge is the spot for a drink. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: The Serai Bandipur, near Bandipur Tiger Reserve, Gundlupet Taluk, Chamarajanagar District, Karnataka 571111

name: Gufha Restaurant — Khan's Resort
area: Melukamanahalli, near Bandipur Gate, Ooty Road
signature_dish: Local Karnataka and North Indian meals
why_it_matters: Gufha Restaurant at Khan's Resort, near the Bandipur Gate on the Ooty road at Melukamanahalli — one of the few dining options within 4 km of the park entrance that is not a high-end resort, useful for travellers who want an affordable meal rather than resort-rate buffets.
insider_tip: Reviews are mixed and the resort side draws cleanliness complaints, but the food and local dishes get reasonable mentions — treat it as a budget alternative to the luxury lodges, not a destination. Cash, UPI and cards.
signature_address: Khan's Resort & Gufha Restaurant, near Bandipur Gate, Ooty Road, Melukamanahalli, Bandipur, Chamarajanagar District, Karnataka 571126
